vocabulary: media-spec (kinds picture/sound/tier/lang/cut). A mark REPLACES the word it stands for; the rest of the label stays text. `symbol` is the poster (sm) artwork, `lockup` the rail (md) artwork. brand = official hex for tone=brand; marks with intrinsic colours (flag) ignore tone.

value_to_mark.object.dts-x: dts (+ ':X' set in the chip's type; no DTS:X artwork exists)
value_to_mark.tier.bluray: bluray, or ultra-hd-bluray when the strip knows resolution=2160p

composition.md: picture: resolution text + range lockup ('4K' + Dolby Vision lockup; '4K' + HDR10 badge; '1080p' alone). sound: object lockup if any (Dolby Atmos lockup) + codec/channels text ('TrueHD 7.1'); else codec lockup + channels text ('DTS-HD MA' lockup + '5.1'); codecs without a lockup = text. tier: mark alone for bluray/dvd; mark + 'Remux'. lang: flag + 'castellano'. cut: IMAX mark alone.
composition.sm: picture: symbol + short text (Dolby D + 'DV'; HDR10+ badge alone; '4K' text alone). sound: symbol + short (Dolby D + 'Atmos'; dts symbol + 'X'). tier: symbol alone. lang: flag alone. cut: IMAX mark alone.

grammar_v3.law: ARTWORK FIRST. A chip is one mark standing FRAMELESS (the artwork is the chip: badge artwork keeps its own box, lockups keep their shape); a drawn word-badge (rounded box + word, HDR10-badge geometry) only for a value with no artwork anywhere.
grammar_v3.provenance: on the mark itself: claim = ghosted (~55% ink); verified = full ink; measured = full ink on a soft wash pill; delivered = wash + ring.
grammar_v3.picture: [resolution mark: 4K/8K/HD/SD tabler badges, 720p drawn] [range mark: Dolby Vision lockup / HDR10 badge / HDR10+ badge / HLG drawn]; SDR omitted.
grammar_v3.sound: [object mark: Dolby Atmos lockup; DTS:X drawn] [codec: lockup when no object shown (DTS-HD MA, TrueHD, DD+, DD, dts, FLAC, Opus), else drawn word (TrueHD); AAC/PCM/… drawn] [channels drawn: 7.1]
grammar_v3.tier: [Blu-ray lockup | Ultra HD Blu-ray at 2160p | DVD lockup | WEB-DL/WEBRip/HDTV/CAM drawn] [+ Remux drawn]
grammar_v3.lang: es-ES: flag (+ castellano drawn at md); es-419: latino drawn; other: code drawn
grammar_v3.sm: brand SYMBOLS (Dolby D, dts, Blu-ray glyph, flag) and the small badges; drawn words at the small rung; md: lockups.
grammar_v3.strip: groups per axis: tight gap within an axis, wider between axes.
